map.标准差代表什么？: What does the standard deviation represent?
map.标准差反映成绩的离散程度（此处为总体标准差 σ=√(Σ(x−均值)²/n)）；值: The standard deviation reflects how spread out the scores are (here it is the population standard deviation σ=√(Σ(x−mean)²/n)); a larger value means wider gaps and clearer polarization among students, a smaller value means the class is more balanced — an important statistic for diagnosing a two-pole split in the class.
map.及格率/优秀率怎么算才对？: How do I compute the pass/excellence rate correctly?
map.及格率=达到及格线人数÷总人数×100%，优秀率同理；关键是及格/优秀分数线要按: Pass rate = count reaching the pass line ÷ total count × 100%, excellence rate similarly; the key is that pass/excellence cutoff lines must be converted by the full-score scale (line percent × full score), not fixed at 60/85 points — at full score 150 the pass line is 90. This tool auto-converts by full score.
